items.title: Cummins Earnings Ahead: What Past Reactions Say About The Stock
items.summary: Cummins (NYSE:CMI) is scheduled to report its earnings on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $69.0 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $34.7 billion in revenue and $3.9 billion in operating profit, with net income of $2.7 billion.
